claim: How many lines a 60 Hz frame has is not settled: the book gives 264 (display from line 40), docs/TECHNIQUES.md gives 262 / 261. Until a board test, wait only for lines below 261 and never for a line the mode may not have.
limit: Unresolved between two sources; neither figure was measured here for every video mode (VGA, HDMI).

evidence.source: I. Novak, Unraveling the ZX Spectrum Next, Vol 1 (2026; core 3.03.03), chapter 10
evidence.text: 60 Hz (NextREG 0x05 bit 2, not Pentagon): 264 lines instead of 311 / 312, display area from line 40, no border above or below the wide area; 58.15 Hz at 128K timing, 59.19 Hz at 48K.
